newsitem.title: USA: Wash. Grand Coulee dam power turbine back on line.
newsitem.headline: Wash. Grand Coulee dam power turbine back on line.

text.p: An 805 megawatt (MW) power turbine at the Grand Coulee hydroelectric dam in Washington state was restarted, as expected, over the weekend, a spokesman for the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation said Monday.
The unit was taken off-line Tuesday for unplanned repair work.
Two of the project's smaller 125 megawatt units remain off-line for scheduled maintenance, the spokesman noted.
Grand Coulee's total generating capacity is near 2,000 MW, but a segment of its turbines are taken off-line in shifts for regular maintenance.
